text: Compose drop and drag-over admission check DROP_FLAVORS against dataTransfer.mozTypesAt(0).contains. The list includes application/x-moz-file. Drag-over still requires getValidAttachments to find a valid attachment before showing its overlay, and extraction checks each dragged item and excludes directories. The internal type check fixes admission; it does not replace attachment validation or establish a platform-wide drag result.
title: Compose drag admission uses internal flavors before attachment validation
